title: Birth in 1908 and non-musical family
summary: Born September 15, 1908 at Maroney and Johnson; only his brother fooled with a horn, no relatives played.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: No, they're just arrows. Just put around this. You know, just one arrow here and one arrow. That was the time of Claude Gable suits come out. Well, they called them the Sheik. They used to have uptown pockets. You see, your pants was made like this, the pockets. They were a little more around in front. Yeah, like that. And they open on the top. Yeah. And I'm dropping that thing. Straight down. Uptown pockets, they call them. When were you born? I was born September 15, 1908. Where were you born? I was born on Maroney and Johnson.
Oh, good. Maroney and Johnson. Any of your family musicals?

No, my brother used to fool around with the horn, but he never played no jazz. He never played nothing. I would just try to fool with it. Well, he was a man then when he was trying to fool with it. He was all that. And I had the old horn around there and he was trying to do it. He was to blow it, you know. He wasn't blowing no pieces, but he could fill it up.
What about uncles and aunts and mother and daddy? None of them played? No, none of them played. None of them played. Hmm. None of them played. How did you get started yourself?
